parsed.title: AOL Ad-Free Sprint
parsed.oneLiner: Enjoy 10 minutes of ad-free news reading after a quick game.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)
AD TODAY native on News Feed Home (e41)
AD TODAY banner on Article Detail Page (e22)

newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed entitlement that suppresses all native and banner advertisements across news feeds and article pages.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app currently has high ad density but lacks a scarcity-based value exchange to drive engagement or sample premium benefits.

parsed.trigger: User is browsing the News Feed Home (s13) or finishes reading an article.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users currently exposed to standard native and banner ad density.

offer.title: Ad-Free for 10 Minutes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to remove all ads for 10 minutes. Enjoy your news.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 10 minutes and offered inline to non-payers, serving as a sampling effect for potential ad-free subscription tiers.

kpis.primary: Net ARPU (total ad revenue per user)
guardrails: Native ad CTR in non-sprint sessions

risks: The 10-minute duration must be carefully monitored to ensure the rewarded eCPM exceeds the opportunity cost of suppressed impressions.
User fatigue if the inline chip appears too frequently in short feeds.

newElements.change: An inline card with a lightning icon and blue gradient background titled 'Ad-Free Sprint' with a 'Play 15s to Go Ad-Free' CTA.
A small chip at the end of the article text inviting the user to start an Ad-Free Sprint for 10 minutes.
A small countdown timer badge next to the Home title indicating the remaining ad-free duration.

callouts.text: User sees standard native ads in the feed.

storyboard.caption: The news feed displays integrated advertising units alongside the top stories.

callouts.text: New Ad-Free Sprint card appears inline.

storyboard.caption: A value-exchange opportunity is introduced directly within the core reading loop.

callouts.text: User taps to start the sprint.

storyboard.caption: A Simula MiniGameInvitation explains the 15-second game and 10-minute reward.
The user plays a quick 15-second game with the AOL character.

callouts.text: Timer begins and native ads are hidden.

storyboard.caption: Ads are removed from the feed for 10 minutes as the reward is granted.
